_comment: GROUND TRUTH — never shown to scoring models. strength: strong|medium|weak-negative. Pairs are unordered {a,b}. Every persona appears in >=1 strong or medium pair. Used to measure gold recall & rank correlation.

strong.why: Non-technical funded founder seeking a Rust co-founder + bored senior Rust fintech engineer wanting a mission — exact mutual fit.
Documentary filmmaker needing source protection + whistleblower-defense lawyer wanting storytellers to loop him in early.
Drummer hunting a bassist to form a band + reliable bassist new in town wanting a drummer/band — classic rhythm-section fit.
Cryptographer with powerful-but-unusable ZK/MPC tech + product designer who makes scary crypto feel human.
Investigative journalist drowning in a leaked dataset (words person) + data scientist craving a meaningful messy dataset + domain partner.
Bitcoin self-custody educator who can't reach non-crypto people + trusted community organizer with underserved networks needing money tools.
Hardware hacker with great boards but weak firmware + embedded firmware engineer wanting to get back to secure hardware.
Privacy/deanonymization researcher offering realistic source-protection threat models + filmmaker who must keep sources safe.
Growth/GTM person seeking a great undistributed privacy product + cryptographer whose powerful tech nobody can use or has heard of.
Angel funding early first-time freedom-tech founders on censorship-resistant payments + exactly such a founder (Mara).

medium.why: Angel investor in freedom tech + established bitcoin educator/builder; plausible funding/network fit though Casimir isn't a first-time founder.
Growth person + bitcoin educator with real content but limited reach; distribution help is plausible.
Threat-model/anonymity researcher + investigative journalist protecting sources; overlapping adversary knowledge.
Whistleblower lawyer + investigative journalist on financial crime; both handle high-risk sources/leaks.
Firmware engineer doing crypto implementations + cryptographer; could implement her protocols on-device.
Plain-language UX writer for scary security + bitcoin educator whose self-custody instructions terrify newcomers.
UX writer + product designer, both making security human; complementary craft on the same product.
Product designer + secure-hardware maker; a hardware wallet needs product/UX design.
Community organizer with real users + investor/mentor; possible support though Fatima isn't pitching a startup.
Data scientist doing graph/anomaly work + privacy researcher on traffic analysis; methodological overlap.
Growth person + funded founder building a product that will need distribution once built.
Veteran network engineer/mentor + senior engineer building resilient infra; war-stories/mentorship value.
Curious full-stack dev wanting a side project + bitcoin educator wanting help building approachable teaching tools for non-experts; a plausible low-stakes collaboration.

weak_negatives_note: All other pairs are intended WEAK. Notable clear non-matches used as stratified negatives include: p18 (aimless tourist) with almost everyone; p20 (retired beekeeper, no project) with most builders; p05/p06 (band) with the crypto/legal/journalism clusters; p03 (filmmaker) with p13/p14 (hardware); p01 (founder) with p05 (drummer).
